subject: BluePeak demo — need broader panel, potential date changes
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BluePeak demo — proposed times and agenda

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood. We'd love to run a focused demo next week to show throughput/latency tradeoffs, VPC/private deployment patterns, and an initial cost/observability walkthrough tailored to your engineering and security leads.

Two slots that work for our team:
- Thu Apr 22, 10:00 AM PT (30–45m)
- Fri Apr 23, 11:00 AM PT (30–45m)

Draft agenda (attached):
1) Quick intros (5m)
2) Overview: runtime + routing (10m)
3) Live demo: short multi-tenant vs private run (15m)
4) Q&A / next steps (10m)

If you want a deeper security or procurement conversation, we can expand the panel — in that case a 60m slot is ideal. Attached: demo-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda stub)

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Aditya —

Thanks for the quick note and the agenda. Heads-up: we just pulled in security and procurement for any new vendor evals — they both need to be on the call for a proper sign-off.

Added: Marcus Holt (Security) and Laura Chen (Procurement) on cc. Also a couple of folks on infra/platform will be traveling next week, so the originally suggested dates may not work.

Can we please look at the week of Apr 26 instead? My preference would be Thu Apr 29 at 11:00 AM PT (60m) so security has time to dig into the architecture. Also, can you send a short SOC 2 summary and notes on SSO/KMS ahead of time so Marcus can triage? Procurement (Laura) will want a list of support/SLAs and any reserved capacity options.

Samir

samir@bluepeak.com | +1 212-555-0178
